# platform-orchestrator_module_version (Data Source)

Reads one immutable Orchestrator Module Version together with its append-only lifecycle, current adoption and optional structural comparison.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Module Version UUID or canonical SemVer.
- `module_id` (String) Module technical slug.

### Optional

- `compare_to` (String) Optional second Version UUID or SemVer for a server-owned structural comparison.

### Read-Only

- `comparison_json` (String) Typed before/after structural comparison when compare_to is set.
- `definition_json` (String) Complete immutable version definition as JSON.
- `lifecycle_events_json` (String) Complete append-only lifecycle timeline as JSON.
- `lifecycle_status` (String)
- `resource_version` (Number)
- `semantic_version` (String)
- `usage_json` (String) Current adoption, Environment, Deployment, Pin and unknown-state evidence as JSON.
- `verification_status` (String)
